topic: Refusals in the app's Needs-you list
detail: SP-048's summary names the app's Needs-you section. This lane kept its Swift changes to the Notifier (SP-051 owns the Spaces pane, SP-074 may edit macos/Sources), so refusals reach the user as macOS notifications only; the menu's Needs you list (NeedsYouSection) still shows PRs. RefusalMonitor.recent (OrchKit) keeps the latest 20 refusals for a list. Proposed: show recent refusals in the Needs-you list or the Spaces pane's needs-you strip once SP-051 merges.
